adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` changed their fallback calendar selection to:

```ts
externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy/undefined (the exact case the fallback is meant to handle), the `find` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined/null`), which will almost never match any real calendar externalId. This makes the fallback resolve to `undefined`, and the subsequent code (e.g., `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"` in `createEvent`, and similarly in delete/update flows) will fall back to the credential's primary calendar rather than the intended destination calendar from `event.destinationCalendar`. Given other parts of the diff now pass arrays of destination calendars and references may not include `externalCalendarId`, this can cause deletes/updates to target the wrong calendar and leave the real event orphaned.
